text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It seems all my training paid off. I was
able to
give a good performance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to celebrate. I only did
what was
expected.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
With today's race behind me, I have to
prepare
for the next.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's not enough. I have to stack up
victories, one
by one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega seems satisfied but retains
a stern
face!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't need you to tell me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I know to keep running... and keep
winning.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I need to be faster, stronger.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll become the brightest star. Just wait
and see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her eyes set dead ahead, I can see
in her
face her desire for victory!
